prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. One square minimal high-end PRODUCT CATALOG photograph showing THREE VIEWS of the same real silver showerhead, no text. Image1 actual front, image2 actual back, image3 actual side are visual authority. Image4 is clay side ONLY to clarify continuous curvature, not material or finished product. Image5 A034 is STYLE ONLY for front/back co-display; do not copy its white face, transparent handle, jet, wording or claims. ACTUAL PRODUCT DETAILS: realistic bright mirror SILVER shell/rim, black finely textured face, dense small off-white separate nozzle rings each with a dark center, original dark microhole outer border. Central RED control is the actual low wide circular flange plus smaller concentric raised boss with dark center opening; do not enlarge relative to neighboring holes, do not replace with a huge doughnut or add a new black pedestal. The separate lower button is the actual shiny SILVER rounded-rectangle in black insert, not black and not a red control. Exact source-photo visual character, not CG clay. No text, letters, logos, arrows, diagrams, performance comparisons, dimensions, filter parts, certificates, human/hand/finger, water or spray. Dry resting product; no press-action, no long red needles, no exploding internals. Real product photographs override all other references. Retain real full product proportion, round head with a clear cylindrical thickness band, shallow rear shell, long smoothly flowing head-to-neck transition and gently curved lower grip. No short shoulder/bulge, no straight flat paddle and no exaggerated gooseneck. SILVER mirror photographed finish, not matte CG steel. Back is smoothly continuous and CLEAN, without central circular spot, sticker, disc, printed mark, patch, scale stain or extra rear button. The circular gray mark in actual back photo is unwanted surface contamination/reflection, NOT a designed part; remove it in studio presentation. No room grid/person reflected in shell; broad clean studio reflections instead.
LAYOUT: white / very pale neutral-gray seamless square. Three separated NON-OVERLAPPING full-length views aligned at their tops and threaded bottoms, each about70% canvas height, top18% and bottom10% clear for later labels. Left x23%: near-front view with red center and silver lower selector; center x55%: rear view with clean mirror back; right x84%: strict SIDE profile, narrow, showing true continuous long shallow C-curve, cylindrical head rim and gradual neck. All three same product size and proportions under consistent soft studio lighting, complete and uncropped, no duplicate ghost bodies. The side head must keep real axial thickness all the way around cylinder, not taper to sharp top. Remove actual hands, hose and quick-release coupler. Every view ends only in short bare SILVER thread (color confirmed), no long adapters. Mild soft contact shadows only, no rocks or decorations. Do not add any labels/text.
